title_zh: CaP-X：机器人操作编码智能体的基准评测与改进框架
one_line: A stateful code executor exposes perception and control primitives, adding iterative execution feedback and visual-to-text grounding; counted simulator trials compare interface tiers.
one_line_zh: 以代码执行器连接感知控制原语，通过仿真试验比较迭代反馈与视觉文本化接口。

title_zh: Guava：通过机器人操作框架将前沿视觉语言模型蒸馏为紧凑智能体
one_line: A shared manipulation harness distills verified teacher trajectories and recovery branches into a 4B agent, supported by controlled ablations and unseen-task execution.
one_line_zh: 共享操作框架以验证轨迹和恢复分支蒸馏4B智能体，由消融及未见任务执行验证。

title_zh: 具身智能体接管控制：最小接口零样本智能体媲美工业规模导航策略
one_line: Models direct observation and primitive actions; matched-backbone simulator comparisons test optional waypoints and SLAM, with repeated success measurements and runtime accounting.
one_line_zh: 模型自主观察与行动；同骨干仿真对照检验可选航点和SLAM，并报告成功率与成本。

title_zh: 用于安全机器人控制的带护栏编程智能体
one_line: SafeHarness externally checks grounded routes and selects obstacle-aware contact strategies; controlled simulator comparisons and 40 real-robot trials support safer execution.
one_line_zh: 外部路线校验与避障接触策略提高安全性，证据来自仿真对照及40次实机试验。

title_zh: 以智能体自身的风格教学：面向网页智能体的黑盒教师蒸馏
one_line: WebKD edits student-visited failures in the student's style and trains with action-weighted, rationale-anchored losses; three-seed browser evaluations show gains.
one_line_zh: 以学生风格修订失败轨迹并加权蒸馏，三种子网页执行评测显示提升。
